sections.text: Project Name: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS Status of Filing in Domicile: Pending Project Number: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS Date Approved in Domicile: Requested Filing Mode: Domicile Status Comments: Kansas is the state of domicile Explanation for Combination/Other: Market Type: Individual Submission Type: New Submission Individual Market Type: Overall Rate Impact: Filing Status Changed: 08/17/2026 State Status Changed: 08/17/2026 Deemer Date: Created By: Shanique Daley Submitted By: Shanique Daley Corresponding Filing Tracking Number: Filing Description: SERFF Tracking #: UNAM-135051123 State Tracking #: Company Tracking #: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS State: Arkansas Filing Company: Nassau Life Insurance Company of Kansas TOI/Sub-TOI: A07I Individual Annuities - Special/A07I.001 Equity Indexed Product Name: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS Project Name/Number: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS/AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS PDF Pipeline for SERFF Tracking Number UNAM-135051123 Generated 08/17/2026 08:50 PM Nassau Life Insurance Company of Kansas NAIC #: 68284 For Approval Purposes Form 26FIAN: Non-Bonus Contract Form 26FIA: Bonus Contract Form 26FIASPN: Non-Bonus Contract Schedule Pages Form 26FIASP: Bonus Contract Schedule Pages Form 26MVA: Market Value Adjustment Amendment Form 26PTPHS: PTP Indexed Account Strategy Rider Form 26NHWP: Nursing Home Waiver Amendment Form 26TIW2P: Terminal Illness Waiver Amendment Form 26GLWB: Flex Forward Rider Form 26GLWB2: Steady Income Rider Form 26EWB: Care Protection Benefit Rider Form 26GMDB: Family Protection Benefit Rider Form 26RSP: Rider Component Specifications We are filing the above-referenced forms for approval. The forms are filed in accordance with the Uniform Standards and are laser printed, subject only to minor variations in paper stock, color, fonts, duplexing, positioning, and pagination. These forms are new and are not intended to replace existing forms. Contract forms 26FIA and 26FIAN are Single Premium Individual Deferred Fixed Indexed Annuity base contracts designed to provide a series of periodic payments based on the Annuitization Value on the Contract Maturity Date and the performance of various selected accounts. These contracts include a return of premium surrender charge and death benefit. These two base contracts are substantially similar except 26FIA includes a premium bonus feature and 26FIAN does not. When 26FIA is issued, the Premium Bonus is applied to the Account Value on the date the premium is applied to the contract. The amount of the Premium Bonus will be based on the amount of the premium payment and the applicable Premium Bonus Percentage shown on the schedule pages. With both contracts, at the time of issue, the initial premium (and any applicable Premium Bonus) will be applied to the contract and allocated in accordance with the premium allocation chosen at the time of application, subject to a Minimum Allocation Percentage and a Minimum Allocation Amount. Both contracts provide fixed and indexed account options to which the client can allocate their premium and Premium Bonus, if applicable. The fixed account will accumulate at a specified interest rate, while any chosen indexed account’s growth will be based on the performance of those particular indexes over a period of time, subject to the terms of any applicable indexed account strategy rider(s) attached to the contract. A negative Index Credit will never be applied to the contract. Forms 26FIASP and 26FIASPN are contract schedule pages and will be issued with a base contract (26FIASP will be issued with 26FIA and 26FIASPN will be issued with 26FIAN). In addition to ordinary case-specific information, the schedule pages will include information regarding the various indexed accounts that are available with the product. These forms are substantially similar except form 26FIASP includes information related to the premium bonus feature of the contract and form 26FIASPN does not. Form 26MVA is a market value adjustment amendment. There is no charge for this amendment and it is not an option selected at the time of application. The company may decide to offer or cease offering this feature for new issues at any time. Form 26PTPHS is a rider form, specific to the indexed account feature of the base contract, which may be used with this SERFF Tracking #: UNAM-135051123 State Tracking #: Company Tracking #: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS State: Arkansas Filing Company: Nassau Life Insurance Company of Kansas TOI/Sub-TOI: A07I Individual Annuities - Special/A07I.001 Equity Indexed Product Name: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS Project Name/Number: AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS/AR - 2026 INCOME CHASSIS PDF Pipeline for SERFF Tracking Number UNAM-135051123 Generated 08/17/2026 08:50 PM product. The form describes a particular indexed account crediting methodology and will be issued with the contract if an indexed account with the particular crediting methodology is offered at the time of issue. Forms 26NHWP and 26TIW2P are nursing home and terminal illness waiver amendments which, if included with the issued contract, will provide a waiver of certain charges if the Owner meets specified criteria. There is no charge for these amendments and they are not an option selected at the time of application. The company may decide to offer or cease offering any of these amendments for new issues at any time. Forms 26GLWB and 26GLWB2 are guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit riders that provide guaranteed withdrawals up to the Annual Benefit Amount each Rider Year following the Rider Exercise Date for the life of the Covered Person(s) regardless of the value of the base contract. These rider forms are substantially similar, with the main difference being that 26GLWB includes an Early Income Benefit Base Bonus feature, whereas 26GLWB2 does not include this feature. There is a charge for these riders. Form 26EWB is a guaranteed withdrawal benefit riders including a Care Benefit Base feature, that provide guaranteed withdrawals up to the Enhanced Benefit Amount following the Rider Exercise Date as long as the Covered Person(s) meets certain qualifying conditions, regardless of the value of the base contract. This rider is issued in conjunction with a guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit rider as part of the same contract. The Enhanced Withdrawal Benefit rider is NOT intended to be qualified for long-term care as defined in the Internal Revenue Code or by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners and does not qualify for any preferred tax treatment. Form 26GMDB, is a guaranteed minimum death benefit rider that provides a death benefit which may exceed that provided by the base annuity contract. Form 26RSP is a specification page that act as a cover page for the guaranteed withdrawal and guaranteed death benefit riders we may offer with our suite of Fixed Indexed Annuity contracts and describes rider terms (“Rider Specifications”) which apply to all of those elected riders (e.g., Rider Fee, Roll-up Period, Roll-up Restart, etc.). The riders that have been elected at the time of application and issued with the contract will appear in the “Rider Components” field. Any reference in the riders to “Rider Components” is referring to the forms listed in this “Rider Components” field. Please refer to this field for the list of riders that each specification page may be used with. At the time of product launch, we intend to use the above forms with the following previously approved forms: Forms OL5630 and OL5631 - Premium Allocation and Rider Election Form (Approval: 12/6/2024, SERFF Tracking no. We will be submitting formal name change applications in each of the individual states. Conclusion: The Department’s procedure as clarified in AID Declaratory Order No. 2016-091 shall apply from the effective date of Bulletin 14-2016, November 9, 2016, and until or unless replaced or superseded by a Rule or change in law.  The rate and form review time period that the Insurance Commissioner has to affirmatively approve or disapprove the form or rate under Ark. Code Ann. Sec. 23-79-109(b)(1) begins when the rate or form is filed with the Department.  The Commissioner may extend that time period by not more than an additional thirty (30) days by giving notice of the extension before expiration of the initial thirty (30) day period pursuant to Ark. Code Ann. Sec. 23-79-109(b)(3).  The initial time frame will no longer be tolled due to unresolved deficiencies or outstanding objections, inquiries, or request for information to the insurer.  The Department will communicate any deficiencies in the filing to the insurer and attempt to resolve prior to the expiration of the time period; however, outstanding deficiencies may result in filings being affirmatively disapproved in order to guard against deficient filings being approved by operation of law.  If disapproved, an insurer may submit, within any applicable deadlines, a new filing for the Department's consideration. Please feel free to contact me if you have questions.
